actionClasses.PROTECT: Winning or measurement-sensitive. Preserve the current search-facing treatment until a clean window closes or a stop-loss fires.
actionClasses.PUSH: Existing demand is already near page one and the surface has an immediate ranking or CTR opportunity. Improve the current canonical owner before building adjacent pages.
actionClasses.EXPAND: The surface has real utility or emerging demand and should gain richer answer coverage, evidence, internal authority, or genuinely distinct supporting content.
actionClasses.CONNECT: The property is strategically useful but under-connected to the Chris Izworski entity, owned-property graph, contextual journeys, or measurement system.
actionClasses.REPAIR: The surface is indexed or useful but ranking, discovery, answer quality, technical readiness, or intent fit is materially weak.
actionClasses.BUILD_NEXT: A distinct, evidence-backed opportunity is worth completing or launching after its production and canonical gates pass.
actionClasses.RETIRE: A surface should only be retired after evidence shows it has no distinct utility, demand, authority, or network role. No current flagship is pre-authorized for retirement.
